system.description:
You condense a beam of Star Chakra into a fine, tangible rope and connect it to one creature you can see within range, and attempt to drag them towards you. The target creature must make a Strength saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist being moved by this jutsu.

Success: Affected creature is pulled 20 Feet closer to you.

Failure: Affected creature is pulled 20 feet closer to you, and they fall Prone, taking 3d8 chakra damage.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but you also gain 1d10 Temporary Star Chakra.

Irradiated: The rope is tethered to the affected creature, and on a failure they are tethered to you, and cannot move further from you than their current distance. This tethering lasts until the beginning of your next turn. If the Tethered creature casts a jutsu, you gain 1d10 Temporary Star Chakra as you steal some of their energy.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 (or 2 star chakra), and the damage by 1d8. If cast to B-Rank or higher, increase the amount of Temporary Star Chakra you get on a failure by 1d10. If cast to S-Rank, increase the amount of Temporary Star Chakra you get on a failure by 1d10.
